text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Нарита Таисин in
the
central plaza.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishiiin! Wait up, Taishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Ticket. Dry your tears before
you go
chasing after her.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: B-but it's my fault Taishin's—waaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Taishin's trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you're aware, there has been
more
talk about the three of us online
lately.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the forum that Ticket
showed us
had some hate directed at
Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Everyone was saying so many nice things
about
us. I had no idea that other stuff
was there!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I'm so sorry, Taishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: No wonder she left without a word to me...

text_block_list.text:
She probably didn't know what to say...
There
were hateful comments about you
as well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
People were saying how it's your fault
for
overworking her and that's why her
condition is so
poor.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There was even mention of how Taishin
would be
better off with another trainer
who can actually
draw out her potential.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I'm overstepping, but could
you please
talk with Taishin?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure what she needs right now are
some words
of encouragement from you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I heard about the comments online.

text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide told you? Ugh, why
are they
literally always sticking their
nose in my business?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Look, I'm totally fine. I'm not gonna get
stuck in
my own head and do something
reckless like
before.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So you can just forget about what you
heard.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: How did you feel when you saw them?

text_block_list.text: Well...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hurt.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I mean, how else am I supposed to feel?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But I've already decided that I'm not
gonna do
anything crazy just because I'm
mad.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to do some solo training right
now...
but I won't.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Then how about you get some rest instead?
You can as long as you don't overdo it!
Nah, train as much as you want!

text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to do some solo training right
now...
but I won't.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Then how about you get some rest instead?
You can as long as you don't overdo it!
Nah, train as much as you want!

text_block_list.text:
Making Нарита Таисин train when she's
feeling
down isn't going to do us any
good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I decide to cancel training for today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What's this?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Hot chocolate. It'll help you calm down.

text_block_list.text: Thanks, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Some moderate training should help
Narita
Taishin improve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I tell her it's probably worse for
her health
to bottle up her stress, she
agrees.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll keep myself in check and be careful
not to
overdo it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The results of her solo training are good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What?! Were you even listening to me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
You'll be fine! You've got me watching over
you!

text_block_list.text: Well... If you say so.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: After training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's nothing like a good run to
clear the
mind.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Nothing. I'm gonna run another lap.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(I feel better now that I've run a few
laps, but I
don't think Trainer does...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, why not blame me
for
getting caught in the crossfire? It's
my fault those
nasty comments even
exist!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (Ugh, dammit! I can't concentrate at all!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, she's able to better

understand herself now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Нарита Таисин and I take
some time to
just relax.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Watching Нарита Таисин run without
worry puts
me in a better mood too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is unable to shed her
frustration,
and she remains just as
stressed as ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
